Instrument & Software Integrations
Controlled exchange layer. Proprietary vendor calculations are not bundled or reimplemented.
Watched folder (automatic import)
Point this at the folder where your instrument or software saves its result files. Every few seconds, new files are imported and hashed automatically using the software, version and method/SOP entered in the form above. A file is only imported if its name contains exactly one registered sample ID (for example FCS-2026-0001_run3.fsa); anything else is listed below and never guessed. Requires Chrome or Edge, and the folder must be chosen again after each reload.

Controlled Report Record
DNA Profile Comparison (STR)
Enter one locus per line: D3S1358, 15, 17 (comma, tab or space separated). Homozygotes: TPOX, 8, 8. More than two alleles at a scene locus indicates a mixture. CSV, TXT, TSV and JSON files are accepted.
Saved Comparisons
DateSuspectScene sampleConclusionLRActions
Forensic DNA Phenotyping
Paste SNP genotypes, one per line (rs12913832 GG, rs12913832, A, G, or a raw 23andMe/Ancestry file). Plus-strand preferred; reverse-strand calls are auto-corrected. STR profiles carry no appearance information; only sex (AMEL, X, Y) is read from them.
Predicted Appearance (composite)
Load a demo or paste genotypes, then press Predict.

Kinship / Parentage Analysis
Used for paternity, maternity, missing-person and disaster victim identification cases. The other parent is optional (duo test if left empty).
Forensic calculators grouped by discipline. Results can be linked to a sample and saved to its record.
How to use this tool
These calculators use established forensic formulas to support your analysis. Always verify results against primary references and validated case data before drawing conclusions.

Scene
Scene examination record
Record what was actually documented at the scene. Do not use this section to state a reconstruction hypothesis as an observed fact.
Origin (0,0) is the top-left (NW) corner. X increases to the right, Y increases downwards. All coordinates are to the centre of each object.
Sketch underlay (your uploaded sketch / photo)
Upload your scene sketch, calibrate it with one known distance, then trace the objects over it. The result is a clean, dimensioned and scaled plan. The page does not read handwriting automatically: you place each object once, and every distance is then computed and drawn exactly.
Display
Add object
Drag objects on the plan, or type exact coordinates below. Arrow keys nudge the selected object.

Selected object
Click an object on the plan or in the list.
Reference points (fixed points used for triangulation)
Place an object by two measured distances
Typical scene method: measure from two fixed points A and B (baseline). Enter both distances; the position is computed from the intersection.
Dimension lines
From → ToPlottedField
Checks
Draw a trajectory / route
Start/end heights give the elevation angle of a bullet path and let the 3D view draw it at the right height. Bearing is measured clockwise from north.
Trajectories in this scene
LabelLengthBearingElev.
Reconstruction frames
1) Arrange objects as they were at the first moment. 2) Capture frame. 3) Move objects to the next moment, set a later time, capture again. Press ▶ under the plan to play the sequence. Positions and rotations are interpolated between frames.
#Namet (s)Basis
Scaled print (true scale)
Print at 100 % / “Actual size” (not “fit to page”). The sheet includes a 100 mm check bar so you can verify the scale with a ruler.

Expert Witness Report — Kenyan court format
Select a case: exhibits, chain of custody, analysis results and saved tool results are pulled in automatically, and relevant constitutional articles, statutes and references are pre-ticked. The legal and reference lists are a starting set. Counsel and the signing expert must verify every citation, and add case-law authorities from Kenya Law (new.kenyalaw.org).
